svg.title: ADEKF predict/update cycle with dual-filter structure and adaptive covariance
svg.desc: Dual EKF: State EKF (left, purple) handles SoC and RC voltages; Parameter EKF (right, coral) handles R0,R1,R2,C1,C2. Adaptive block updates Q and R from the innovation sequence. θ̂k-1 feeds the state model predict step.
